get_started.title: Get started
get_started.description: Your AI connects to your Rafflex account and sets up, then builds with you while you watch here.
get_started.text: Set me up to build for the Rafflex marketplace. Follow __BASE_URL__/start.md step by step, and ask me before anything that needs my approval.

iterate.title: Change something
iterate.description: Tell your AI what to change and it updates this product.
iterate.text:
Change {title} in {path}: [DESCRIBE THE CHANGE]. If that is still in brackets, ask me what to change first.

Follow AGENTS.md. When you are done, run `npx @rafflex/dev verify {path}` and fix anything that blocks. Do not push it to the marketplace until I say so.

fix.title: Fix the issues
fix.description: Your AI fixes everything the last test found.

fix_issue.title: Fix this issue
fix_issue.description: Your AI fixes this one issue.
fix_issue.text:
Fix this in {title} ({path}): {issue}

Then run `npx @rafflex/dev verify {path}` and fix anything else that blocks. Do not push it to the marketplace until I say so.

next_version.title: Start the next version
next_version.description: Your AI asks what should change, then sets up the next version.
next_version.text:
Start the next version of {title} in {path}. The live version is {live_version}.

Ask me what should change. Suggest the next version from that (a patch for fixes, a minor version for something new), then set it with `npx @rafflex/dev version {path} <x.y.z>`. Write the release notes under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md, make the changes, and run `npx @rafflex/dev verify {path}` until nothing blocks. Do not push it to the marketplace until I say so.

revert.title: Go back to an earlier version
revert.description: Your AI brings back a version you published before.
revert.text:
Take {title} back to an earlier version I published on the marketplace. List its published versions and ask me which one I want.

Then call `revert_to_version` with that version, call `export_product`, and bring the result into {path} with `npx @rafflex/dev import`. Run `npx @rafflex/dev verify {path}` and tell me what changed.

hand_to_ai.title: Hand it to your AI
hand_to_ai.description: Your AI picks up where this product stands.
hand_to_ai.text: Pick up {title} in {path}. Run `npx @rafflex/dev status {path} --json` and tell me where it stands in two lines. Then ask me what to change.

get_it_live_first.title: Get it live
get_it_live_first.description: Your AI checks it, adds it to the marketplace, and sends it for review.
get_it_live_first.text: Run `npx @rafflex/dev verify {path}` and fix anything that blocks. Then push {title} to the marketplace as a new product, and submit {version} for review with the notes in CHANGELOG.md.

get_it_live.title: Get it live
get_it_live.description: Your AI checks it, pushes the changes, and sends this version for review.
get_it_live.text: Run `npx @rafflex/dev verify {path}` and fix anything that blocks. Then push {title}, and submit {version} for review with the notes in CHANGELOG.md.

check_review.title: Check the review
check_review.description: Your AI asks the marketplace where the review stands.
check_review.text: Check where the review of {title} {version} stands. Call `get_product`, pipe the result into `npx @rafflex/dev synced {path}`, and tell me in one line.

fix_review.title: Fix what the reviewer asked for
fix_review.description: Your AI makes every change the reviewer asked for.
fix_review.text: Read the reviewer's feedback on {title} with `get_product` and fix every point in {path}. Run `npx @rafflex/dev verify {path}` until nothing blocks, then push it. Submit {version} for review again only when I confirm.

new_product.title: Build it with your AI
new_product.description: Describe what you want and your AI builds it in this folder.
new_product.text:
Build {title} in {path}: [DESCRIBE IT HERE]. If that is still in brackets, ask me what it should do first.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run `npx @rafflex/dev verify {path}` and fix anything that blocks. Do not push it to the marketplace until I say so.

new_product_ai_start.title: Or ask your AI to start it
new_product_ai_start.description: Your AI creates the folder and asks you what it should do.
new_product_ai_start.text:
Start a new {type} called {title}. Run `npx @rafflex/dev new {type} "{title}"`, then ask me what it should do and build it.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run `npx @rafflex/dev verify` on the new folder and fix anything that blocks. Do not push it to the marketplace until I say so.

clients.label: Claude Code
clients.connect: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user rafflex __BASE_URL__/mcp

clients.label: Codex
clients.connect:
codex mcp add rafflex --url __BASE_URL__/mcp
codex mcp login rafflex
